en: An old sepia-toned postcard showing a tree-lined street or avenue with a large building featuring a porch and ornate wooden railing on the left. A person, possibly a child, stands on the street in front of the building. The scene extends into the distance with more trees and some distant structures, evoking a tranquil, small-town or suburban setting. The postcard has printed text in a decorative font.
